title: New schedule opens an empty Untitled schedule editor
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on for the shop (it ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings choose "Maintenance" (it sits beneath "Inspection Templates"). Schedules here belong to the location chosen in the header.
custom_steps:
1. In Settings > Maintenance click New schedule.
  2. Read the editor that opens - its title and whether any modal or template chooser appears.
  3. Leave the editor without saving, return to the schedule list, and look for a draft.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • New schedule opens straight into an empty editor titled "Untitled schedule" - no modal and no template to choose.
  • The schedule exists only from its first Save; leaving before that leaves nothing in the list (no draft).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10558 (S1, Create a maintenance schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), Part 1 / S1; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R3: “New schedule opens an empty editor titled Untitled schedule. There is no modal and no template”
  • S1-R4: “A schedule exists from its first Save. Leaving the editor before that leaves nothing behind”
